text: Refines D-0343 and D-0353 for #639, step 7 of #571's statechart plan: a fork offering alternative modeled behaviors carries a checked preview for every option before its decision request publishes. Each option has its own isolated model, sibling includes, candidate statements, faithful bounds and pure view, checked with pinned TLC through the ordinary model, complete graph, rule replay and hiding checks, and its preview binds the fork and option IDs and words, the effective prior choices, its diagnostics and its model-only receipt. The caller stages parent and choice context before the agent runs, and the tool checks and the final check both use it. One check reports every option's failure, and only a complete validated set publishes or exports. Previews are unratified and model-only: choosing one ratifies no rule and starts no build, and the selected model's verification computes its own chart. Plumbing, PRD and caller-authenticated D-0328 step_fit questions stay chart-free, and preview-less fork comments are unchanged. A request with previews publishes whole or not at all, within the comment limit and the 4 MiB marker limit, and a failed check's post leaves an oversized proposal to the saved run. The dashboard shows a fork's options together, under cache identities that bind repository, issue, fork, option, words, sources, choices, diagnostics, tools and rendered contents, and restores each option apart from project receipts, so a damaged option gets its own diagnostic while healthy siblings survive restart. Damaged project evidence still discards the saved whole-page snapshot.
